risks.title: Live platform evidence gaps
risks.description: This environment cannot query live Render, GitHub API, Google Play, or App Store Connect; status can drift without immediate detection.
risks.impact: Could miss regression in staging or store-side readiness.
risks.mitigation: Perform periodic manual platform checks before each release.

risks.title: iOS production readiness gap
risks.description: Production iOS app record and release path are not active.
risks.impact: Cannot release iOS to production from current code-path.
risks.mitigation: Maintain explicit future-state plan before feature freeze.

risks.title: Legacy Android identity
risks.description: Legacy package com.kurioticket.mobile remains documented for historical reasons.
risks.impact: Risk of accidental routing/confusion if build scripts are mis-targeted.
risks.mitigation: Keep explicit identity gating in workflows and scripts.

risks.title: Inherited test debt
risks.description: A small set of stable test failures persists from unrelated baseline behavior.
risks.impact: Reduces confidence in full verification signal and can mask new regressions.
risks.mitigation: Track as technical debt; resolve before freeze.

risks.title: Complex automation graph
risks.description: Multiple workflow entry points (preview/dev/prod) increase operational complexity.
risks.impact: Higher cognitive load for onboarding and troubleshooting.
risks.mitigation: Use this handbook as source of truth and runbook entries.

risks.title: Required-check availability
risks.description: Conclusive required checks depend on workflow applicability logic and branch changes.
risks.impact: A path-filter mistake can mask incomplete validation.
risks.mitigation: Use always-created checks with explicit non-applicable success paths.
